svg.title: Coastguard officer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as coastguard officer, wearing a rescue jacket and a rescue helmet. Visible work cue: A four-section life ring has a visible central opening and a trailing rescue rope. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a rescue helmet.
